
 Usage: agentos up [OPTIONS]

 Set up and start this box, then print a sign-in link.

 The first time, it writes node.toml (as `agentos node init`) and
 controller.toml.

 It runs a controller and this node, joined, and prints the panel and a
 one-time sign-in link.

 Safe to run again: settings and tokens are kept. By hand: `agentos connect
 --by-hand`.

 With Claude Code or Codex on this machine (or `--here`), they connect to it
 too, with no tunnel.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --controller-port                    <int range>         Controller port     │
│                                      [1<=x<=65535]       (default from       │
│                                                          controller.toml).   │
│ --ssh-host                           <str>               This box's SSH      │
│                                                          alias, for the      │
│                                                          connect line.       │
│ --here                 --not-here                        Also connect Claude │
│                                                          Code and Codex on   │
│                                                          this machine        │
│                                                          straight to the     │
│                                                          node, with their    │
│                                                          own grant (Linux;   │
│                                                          the default when    │
│                                                          either is installed │
│                                                          here).              │
│ --verbose          -v                                    Debug logging.      │
│ --help                                                   Show this message   │
│                                                          and exit.           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
